speaker: Doctor
text:
The patient's symptoms of fever, uterine tenderness, and urinary frequency following a difficult vaginal delivery with a large infant are classic signs of postpartum endometritis, rather than iron deficiency anemia which would not present with acute fever and localized tenderness. The normal D-dimer and Chest X-ray have ruled out pulmonary embolism, keeping the focus on the uterine infection.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis
